BETA Close X Serco Group PLC has executed share buybacks between April 27 and April 30, 2026, purchasing a total of 1,030,327 ordinary shares at an average price of approximately 279.57 pence per share. Following these transactions, the company's total issued ordinary shares, excluding treasury shares, stand at 993,518,687, with 9,227,327 shares held in treasury. The total number of voting rights, excluding treasury shares, is also 993,518,687 as of April 30, 2026.
